column4: dialect-gated: cleat#982's two instrument tests need a live SQL Server -- one installs an AFTER DELETE trigger, the other measures a row that is physically present and hidden by a filter predicate. Neither mechanism exists on PostgreSQL, so they skip in this PostgreSQL-only job and RUN in test-mssql.
